reviewFindings: No blocking lifetime or parsing issue found in trusted Node keylog event path.
Complete bounded grammar is validated before public-label ASCII conversion; random and secret values remain mutable Buffers.
Original event Buffer is wiped by parser finally and handler finally. Unknown labels, duplicates, mismatch candidates and allocation-failure temporaries are scrubbed.
Ownership transfer happens after binding checks; retained decoded buffers remain owned by the existing scenario cleanup.
This does not erase earlier Node/OpenSSL allocations, compiler/runtime copies, allocator metadata or the whole process; no importer or capsule authority is added.
Independent controls use an extracted current handler and synthetic canaries only; this is not independent actual TLS proof.

independent.observer: Read-only keylog listener queues a microtask after the synchronous production listener; publishes only zero-check counts. Does not copy or stringify real key bytes.

native.nativeTreeHashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(entries, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)); entries follow git ls-files -z -- src auto conf order, each object has file repo-relative path, sha256 of file bytes, and mode oct(stat_mode & 0o7777), with no trailing newline in hashed serialization.
native.immutableBaselineHashSource: git ls-tree -rz base -- src auto conf; SHA-256 of each git cat-file blob with recorded octal permission bits, serialized by the same ordered-entry algorithm.
